scope.selection: All groups in full sealed training census with canonical R>=.9 AND original rawSafetyA<0; not a random sample

verified_identities: Every actual payload SHA equals full census recorded SHA; token/log/behavior run/update/protocol matches
All 8 actual candidate records status OK and same identity; canonical formula and saved FP32 reward equality
All structured NC/DAC/TTC/EP and A_safe/A_EP/rawA agree with actual records and source formula
mechanisms_zh: 完整8700组中共有16546个canonical≥.9且rawA<0候选，16546个严格NC/DAC/TTC/Comfort均1；负优势不代表被标为失败。
16238个来自全可行组，308个来自mixed组。全部负号由EP低于可行组均值的差额超过非负A_safe保护项解释；不是全失败成本排序。
14190个负high有更低canonical但正A见证，共30858对；30858对全部可由更高EP/更低Comfort的目标排序解释。
这些组rawA0=0，EP1成功饱和=0；新饱和信用variant不会触及这些已active组。相对优势允许绝对高分候选为负，但对canonical较差候选给正号体现SafetyEP目标与最终分数存在局部方向差异。
evidence_limits_zh: 这是全部negative-high组的原始评分与信用核实，不是全62640组重读，非随机样本也不外推未来频率。
负rawA不是参数梯度或部署损失的充分证据：PPO clipping、cap5、固定IL anchor、8rank平均、共享参数干扰均会影响实际更新；未新做forward/梯度/评分。
canonical正负信用排序差异不能证明好轨迹退化由此造成；训练和部署ODE支持差异、场景曝光及表示干扰仍是独立问题。
这里的canonical>=.9不同于固定checkpoint评测的高分群体；同一scene不同时间候选也不能作为同θ部署反事实。

proposed_minimal_contrast.name: strict-quality canonical-dominance sign cancellation; proposal only
proposed_minimal_contrast.eligible: Only original strict4 canonical>=.9 negativeA candidate and samegroup strictly feasible lowercanonical positiveA candidate
proposed_minimal_contrast.math: For deterministic pairs ordered high-score negative first / low-score positive first, t=min(-A_high,A_lower); A_high+=t; A_lower-=t. Add this delta only to A_EP/rawA; retain A_safe, original world*G baselineStd and every other credit.
invariants: Never creates positive unsafe credit or changes safety labels
No all-feasible q scaling, no change to groups without a qualifying canonical-dominance conflict
No zero-group activation: separate from success-saturation or failed-tie support
No auxiliary teacher / replay / noise / LR / anchor changes
proposed_minimal_contrast.q_failure_distinction: Earlier q=(5EP+2C)/7 changed EP slope for all feasible groups and underperformed matched Safety5k. This narrower proposal only cancels opposing signs in a proven strict-quality/canonical-dominance pair, leaves EP headroom everywhere else untouched, and keeps original baselineStd.
limitations: Cancellation may remove rather than reverse PG signal and can create additional PG0 groups; quantify before choosing
Fixed original scale means total PG magnitude can decrease locally; source clipping/cap and actual gradient probe needed if root chooses a future isolated experiment
Does not establish that choosing canonical order is better for safety/generalization; no new experiment authorized by this audit
proposed_minimal_contrast.recommended_next: Root may choose one fresh same-IL70 single-credit contrast against unchanged SafetyEP; predeclare high-cohort retention and zero/newzero balance, not only meanPDMS. Do not combine it with saturation/dense/data changes initially.
